items.claim: Alden Cora was a plus 350 underdog in his UFC debut against Aleandro Costa.
items.quote: Alden Cora came in and took on Aleandro Costa in his debut and me and everybody in my private community bet him at plus 350 odds

items.claim: Alden Cora finished Aleandro Costa via TKO in round three of his UFC debut.
items.quote: he won that fight in round three, finished him with a TKO

items.claim: Alden Cora was a minus 1000 favorite in his fight against Stuart Nickel.
items.quote: in his last fight, that's only two fights later, he was minus 1,000 odds to Stuart Nickel.
